subsection.name: Classified Information
description: verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are cleared and indoctrined to the highest classification level of the information to which they ahve access on the system

subsection.name: Formal Indoctrination
description: verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting types of classified informatino that require formal indoctrination, are fomrally indoctrinated for all the relevant types of information to which they have access on the system

subsection.name: Information Requiring Special Protective Meaures
description: verfy that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting information requiring special protections
have valid access authorizations that are demostated by assigned official government duties
satisfy organization defined additional personnel screenign criteria

subsection.name: Citizenship Requirements
description: verify that individuals accessing a system processing, storing, or transmitting orgnaization defined information types meet organization defined citizneship requirements

subsection.name: Post Employment Requirements
description: notify terminated individuals of applicable, legally binding post employment requirements for the protection of organizational information
require terminated individuals to sign an acknowledgment of post employment requirements as part of the organizational termination process

subsection.name: Automated Actions
description: use organization defined automated mechanisms to notify organization defined personnel or roles of individual termination actions, disable access to system resources

subsection.name: Classified Information Requiring Special Protection
description: verify that acess to classified information requiring special protection is granted only to individuals who
have a valid access authorization that is demonstrated by assigned official government duties
have read, understood, and signed a nondisclosure agreement

subsection.name: Post Employment Requirements
description: notify individuals of applicable, legally binding post employment requirements for protection of organizational information
require individuals to sign an acknowledgement of these requirements, if applicable, as part of granting initial access to covered information
